caption: A red umbrella is opened in bright sun, and the ground and objects beneath it take on a red tint.

sa.check: The ground and objects beneath it take on a red tint.
The umbrella opens first and the tint appears with it.

pc.expect: The red tint appears only in the umbrella's shade and the ground outside keeps its normal colour.
pc.fail: The tint is outside the shade; or the shade is plain grey with no tint; or the tint is a different colour.

pc.expect: The tint appears only after the umbrella opens and would disappear when it closes.
pc.fail: It is there before the umbrella opens; or remains after closing; or the umbrella opens and no tint appears.

pc.expect: The shade lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or directly beneath under a low sun; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The canopy opens as taut fabric on ribs.
pc.fail: It is rigid like a plate; or floats off; or tears.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or the shade becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The umbrella and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The canopy changes colour; or the ground changes; or the objects rearrange.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
